title: Zone length
statement: For any index type $I$, payload family $f:\mathbb Z\to I\to\mathrm{OblPayload}$, integer coordinate $z$, caching flag, and natural number $n$, the zone of length $n$ starting at $z$ has list length exactly $n$.
replaced:
For every payload family, starting coordinate, caching flag, and length $n$, the zone
of $n$ rows is a list of length exactly $n$; every guide cell thus contributes exactly
one parallel data row.
